div.head: Grið 27
div.ab: Oððon hwilcan geþance mæg ænig man æfre geþencan on his mode, þæt he to sacerdan heafod ahylde 7 bletsunge gyrne 7 heora mæssan on cyrcan gestande 7 æt hlafgange heora hand cysse, 7 sona þær æfter hy hrædlice syððan scyrde oððe scynde mid worde oððe weorce?

Oððon hwilcan geþance mæg ænig man æfre geþencan on his mode þæt he to sacerdan heafod ahylde, and bletsunge gyrne, and heora mæssan on cyrcan gestande, and æt hlafgange heora hand cysse, and sona þær æfter hy hrædlice syððan scyrde oððe scynde mid worde oððe weorce?

Oder mit welcher Überlegung kann jemand jemals in seinem Sinne sich [dázu] entschliessen, dass er vor den Priestern das Haupt neigt und Segen erbittet und ihren Messen in der Kirche beiwohnt und beim Abendmahlsempfange ihre Hand küsst, sofort jedoch danach sie dann schnell verletzt oder bedrängt durch Wort oder That?

Or with what consideration can anyone ever resolve in his mind [to do this]: that he bows his head before the priests and asks for blessing and attends their masses in church and kisses their hand at communion, yet immediately afterwards quickly injures or oppresses them by word or deed?

Or by what stretch of the imagination can anyone ever think in his mind that he may bow his head to the priests, desire their blessings, attend their Masses in church, and kiss their hand during the procession with the host, yet then immediately thereafter injure or abuse them by word or deed?
